items.name: Finsupp.multinomial
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → (α →₀ ℕ) → ℕ

items.name: Nat.multinomial
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → Finset α → (α → ℕ) → ℕ

items.name: Finsupp.multinomial_update
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α) (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = (f.sum fun x => id).choose (f a) * (f.update a 0).multinomial

items.name: Finset.prod_pow_choose_succ
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ),
  ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ (n + 1).choose i =
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ n.choose i) *
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f (i + 1) (n - i) ^ n.choose i

items.name: Finsupp.multinomial_eq
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial f.support ⇑f

items.name: Nat.binomial_eq_choose
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],
  a ≠ b → Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).choose (f a)

items.name: Nat.multinomial_cons
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {a : α} (ha : a ∉ s) (f : α → ℕ),
  Nat.multinomial (Finset.cons a s ha) f = (f a + ∑ i ∈ s, f i).choose (f a) * Nat.multinomial s f

items.name: Nat.multinomial_insert
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {a : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],
  a ∉ s → ∀ (f : α → ℕ), Nat.multinomial (insert a s) f = (f a + ∑ i ∈ s, f i).choose (f a) * Nat.multinomial s f

items.name: Finsupp.multinomial_eq_of_support_subset
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α →₀ ℕ} {s : Finset α}, f.support ⊆ s → f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial s ⇑f

items.name: Nat.multinomial_univ_two
items.type: ∀ (a b : ℕ), Nat.multinomial Finset.univ ![a, b] = (a + b).factorial / (a.factorial * b.factorial)

items.name: Nat.binomial_spec
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],
  a ≠ b → (f a).factorial * (f b).factorial * Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).factorial

items.name: Nat.multinomial_spec
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ), (∏ i ∈ s, (f i).factorial) * Nat.multinomial s f = (∑ i ∈ s, f i).factorial

items.name: BinomialRing.multichoose
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → {inst : AddCommMonoid R} → {inst_1 : Pow R ℕ} → [self : BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R

items.name: Finset.sum_choose_succ_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (n + 1).choose i • f i (n + 1 - i) =
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose i • f i (n + 1 - i) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose i • f (i + 1) (n - i)

items.name: Ring.multichoose
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommMonoid R] → [inst_1 : Pow R ℕ] → [BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R

items.name: Nat.binomial_eq
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],
  a ≠ b → Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).factorial / ((f a).factorial * (f b).factorial)

items.name: Nat.instBinomialRing
items.type: BinomialRing ℕ

items.name: Nat.multinomial_empty
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → ℕ), Nat.multinomial ∅ f = 1

items.name: Nat.multinomial_pos
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ), 0 < Nat.multinomial s f

items.name: Nat.multinomial_congr
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {f g : α → ℕ}, (∀ a ∈ s, f a = g a) → Nat.multinomial s f = Nat.multinomial s g
